## 🚀 How Automation Works

### setup.ps1 Magic

**Phase 1: Project Detection** (15 seconds)
```
Scans for:
- .sln, *.csproj → .NET project
- package.json → Node.js project  
- *.py, requirements.txt → Python project
- pom.xml, build.gradle → Java project
- Gemfile → Ruby project

Detects frameworks:
- Microsoft.AspNetCore → ASP.NET Core
- "react" in dependencies → React
- Django files → Django
```

**Phase 2: Workspace Creation** (5 seconds)
```
Creates:
- Workspaces/Copilot/learning/patterns/
- Workspaces/Copilot/validation/
- Workspaces/Documentation/
- Workspaces/Testing/

Initializes:
- successful-patterns.json
- failed-approaches.json
- refactoring-wins.json
```

**Phase 3: Tool Installation** (3-5 minutes)
```
Auto-installs based on project:
- .NET → Roslynator
- Any → Playwright (E2E tests)
- Any → ESLint, Prettier (code quality)
```

**Phase 4: Configuration** (10 seconds)
```
Replaces placeholders:
- {{PROJECT_NAME}} → Detected name
- {{BUILD_COMMAND}} → Detected command
- {{TEST_COMMAND}} → Detected command
- {{PRIMARY_LANGUAGE}} → C#/JavaScript/Python/etc.
- {{ARCHITECTURE}} → Detected architecture

Generates:
- .github/prompts/*.md (6 agents)
- .github/instructions/*.md (7 instructions)
```

**Phase 5: Validation** (5 seconds)
```
Checks:
- Git repository exists
- Workspace structure created
- All files generated
- Build command works
```

**Phase 6: Summary** (2 seconds)
```
Creates PROJECT-SETUP-SUMMARY.md with:
- Your project configuration
- Installed components
- Next steps
- Troubleshooting
```

**Total: ~5 minutes** (vs 90 minutes manual)
